This indicator refers mainly to the implementation of activities in the framework of two agreements that are still in negotiation phase EUMexico Global Agreement and EU Central America Association Agreement

Whereas the programme did not contribute directly to the development specific partnership strategies it has enhanced the EUs strategic engagements on a number of important topics. Specifically 1 the programme has informed the EUs approach to and engagements with the South African Government on black economic empowerment and local content regulations 2 it has strengthened collaboration between the EU and the South African Government on GIs 3 it has served to develop and communication positions on energy regulation to the national department and the regulator 4 it has informed and deepened discussions between the EUD government and business around EPA trade opportunities and 5 it has supported the organisation and facilitation of a regional trade seminar and planning workshop for DG Trade officials.
